    32	/-- A formalization-only identity used to construct canonical line
    33	descriptions: applying the canonical line-representative projection twice has
    34	the same effect as applying it once. -/
    35	theorem lineRepMap_apply_self {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    36	    (v u : Fin m → K) :
    37	    lineRepMap v (lineRepMap v u) = lineRepMap v u := by
    38	  simp [lineRepMap, canonicalProjOfKernel, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    39	
    40	/-- The two presentations of lines used by the low-degree question sampler. -/
    41	inductive LineKind where
    42	  | axis
    43	  | diagonal
    44	  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype
    45	
    46	/-- A seed-bearing line description for `def:line-point-dist`, blueprint
    47	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:85-95`, paper
    48	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:143-174,243-287`.
    49	
    50	An axis description stores its canonical base and seed. A diagonal description
    51	stores only the projected direction, together with its prefix-zero invariant.
    52	Both cases carry the assertion that their base is fixed by the
    53	appropriate `lineRepMap`. Coordinates are numbered from zero; coordinate `j`
    54	corresponds to the paper's coordinate `j + 1`. -/
    55	inductive LineDesc (L : LdParams) where
    56	  | axis (base : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) (seed : ScalarQ L)
    57	      (baseFixed : lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex L seed)) base = base)
    58	  | diagonal (base : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) (seed : ScalarQ L)
    59	      (direction : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)
    60	      (baseFixed : lineRepMap direction base = base)
    61	      (prefixZero : ∀ j : Fin L.m, j.val < (chiIndex L seed).val → direction j = 0)
    62	  deriving DecidableEq
    63	
    64	/-- The tag of a canonical line description. -/
    65	def LineDesc.kind {L : LdParams} : LineDesc L → LineKind
    66	  | .axis _ _ _ => .axis
    67	  | .diagonal _ _ _ _ _ => .diagonal
    68	
    69	/-- The seed retained by a canonical line description. -/
    70	def LineDesc.seed {L : LdParams} : LineDesc L → ScalarQ L
    71	  | .axis _ seed _ => seed
    72	  | .diagonal _ seed _ _ _ => seed
    73	
    74	/-- The canonical base stored by a line description. -/
    75	def LineDesc.base {L : LdParams} : LineDesc L → Fin L.m → ScalarQ L
    76	  | .axis base _ _ => base
    77	  | .diagonal base _ _ _ _ => base
    78	
    79	/-- The geometric direction represented by a canonical line description.
    80	Diagonal descriptions already store the projected data, so this map does
    81	not apply a second projection. -/
    82	def LineDesc.direction {L : LdParams} (line : LineDesc L) :
    83	    Fin L.m → ScalarQ L :=
    84	  match line with
    85	  | .axis _ seed _ => coordinateDirection (chiIndex L seed)
    86	  | .diagonal _ _ direction _ _ => direction
    87	
    88	/-- The canonical base is fixed by the representative map of the line's
    89	geometric direction. -/
    90	theorem LineDesc.base_fixed {L : LdParams} (line : LineDesc L) :
    91	    lineRepMap line.direction line.base = line.base := by
    92	  cases line with
    93	  | axis base seed baseFixed => exact baseFixed
    94	  | diagonal base seed direction baseFixed prefixZero => exact baseFixed
    95	
    96	/-- Every diagonal description carries the source prefix-zero invariant. -/
    97	theorem LineDesc.diagonal_prefix_zero {L : LdParams} (line : LineDesc L)
    98	    (hline : line.kind = .diagonal) :
    99	    ∀ j : Fin L.m, j.val < (chiIndex L line.seed).val → line.direction j = 0 := by
   100	  cases line with
   101	  | axis base seed baseFixed => simp [LineDesc.kind] at hline
   102	  | diagonal base seed direction baseFixed prefixZero => exact prefixZero
   103	
   104	/-- The point set represented by a seed-bearing line description. -/
   105	noncomputable def LineDesc.pointSet {L : LdParams} (line : LineDesc L) :
   106	    Set (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) :=
   107	  linePoints line.base line.direction
   108	
   109	/-- Multivariate polynomials in `m` variables whose total degree is at most
   110	`d`. This is the class `deg_d` in `def:ideg-deg-polynomials`, blueprint
   111	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:37-48`, paper
   112	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:51-52`. -/
   113	abbrev TotalDegreePoly (m : ℕ) (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K] (d : ℕ) :=
   114	  {p : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K // p.totalDegree ≤ d}
   115	
   116	/-- Coefficient-list representation of a univariate polynomial of degree at
   117	most `c` over the scalar field of `L`. -/
   118	abbrev DegPoly (L : LdParams) (c : ℕ) := Fin (c + 1) → ScalarQ L
   119	
   120	/-- Extend a coefficient list by zero from degree bound `c` to `c'`. -/
   121	def DegPoly.padTo {L : LdParams} {c c' : ℕ} (_h : c ≤ c')
   122	    (f : DegPoly L c) : DegPoly L c' :=
   123	  fun i =>
   124	    if hi : i.val < c + 1 then f ⟨i.val, hi⟩ else 0
   125	
   126	/-- A line polynomial evaluates to `a` at `u` when `u` has a line parameter
   127	and every such parameter gives the same value.  The universal clause handles
   128	the zero-direction presentation without choosing a sentinel parameter. -/
   129	def EvaluatesTo {L : LdParams} {c : ℕ} (line : LineDesc L)
   130	    (f : DegPoly L c) (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) (a : ScalarQ L) : Prop :=
   131	  (∃ t : ScalarQ L, u = line.base + t • line.direction) ∧
   132	    ∀ t : ScalarQ L, u = line.base + t • line.direction → evalCoefficient f t = a
   133	
   134	/-- Partially evaluate a line polynomial at a point. The value is undefined
   135	when the point does not determine an evaluation. This formalization-only
   136	completion is used in blueprint chapter 14; the displayed family at paper
   137	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:197-206` has no bottom outcome. -/
   138	noncomputable def evalOpt {L : LdParams} {c : ℕ} (line : LineDesc L)
   139	    (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) (f : DegPoly L c) : Option (ScalarQ L) := by
   140	  classical
   141	  exact if h : ∃ a : ScalarQ L, EvaluatesTo line f u a then
   142	    some (Classical.choose h)
   143	  else none
   144	
   145	/-- Convert an axis-line CL output to its seed-bearing presentation; paper
   146	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-257,276-287`. -/
   147	def aLineDescOf (L : LdParams) (line : LdSpace L) : LineDesc L :=
   148	  let direction := coordinateDirection (chiIndex L line.seed)
   149	  let base := lineRepMap direction line.point
   150	  LineDesc.axis base line.seed (lineRepMap_apply_self direction line.point)
   151	
   152	/-- Convert a diagonal-line CL output to its seed-bearing presentation; paper
   153	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:261-287`. -/
   154	def dLineDescOf (L : LdParams) (line : LdSpace L) : LineDesc L :=
   155	  let direction := prefixProjection (chiIndex L line.seed) line.direction
   156	  let base := lineRepMap direction line.point
   157	  LineDesc.diagonal base line.seed direction
   158	    (lineRepMap_apply_self direction line.point) (by
   159	      intro j hj
   160	      change prefixProjection (chiIndex L line.seed) line.direction j = 0
   161	      rw [prefixProjection, if_pos hj])
   162	
   163	/-- The axis-line/point component of the low-degree line-point sampler; paper
   164	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-257,274-287`. -/
   165	noncomputable def aLinePointDist (L : LdParams) :
   166	    Distribution (LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)) :=
   167	  (clDistribution (ldALineCL L) (ldPointCL L)).map fun sample =>
   168	    (aLineDescOf L sample.1, LdSpace.point sample.2)
   169	
   170	/-- The diagonal-line/point component of the low-degree line-point sampler; paper
   171	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:261-287`. -/
   172	noncomputable def dLinePointDist (L : LdParams) :
   173	    Distribution (LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)) :=
   174	  (clDistribution (ldDLineCL L) (ldPointCL L)).map fun sample =>
   175	    (dLineDescOf L sample.1, LdSpace.point sample.2)
   176	
   177	/-- The equal mixture of axis and diagonal line-point samples from
   178	`def:line-point-dist`; paper
   179	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`. -/
   180	noncomputable def linePointDist (L : LdParams) :
   181	    Distribution (LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)) :=
   182	  Distribution.mix (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
   183	    (aLinePointDist L) (dLinePointDist L)
   184	
   185	/-- The affine line-point component has total probability one. -/
   186	theorem aLinePointDist_isProbability (L : LdParams) :
   187	    (aLinePointDist L).IsProbability := by
   188	  change (aLinePointDist L).totalWeight = 1
   189	  rw [aLinePointDist, Distribution.map_totalWeight, clDistribution,
   190	    Distribution.map_totalWeight]
   191	  exact uniformDistribution_isProbability _
   192	
   193	/-- The diagonal line-point component has total probability one. -/
   194	theorem dLinePointDist_isProbability (L : LdParams) :
   195	    (dLinePointDist L).IsProbability := by
   196	  change (dLinePointDist L).totalWeight = 1
   197	  rw [dLinePointDist, Distribution.map_totalWeight, clDistribution,
   198	    Distribution.map_totalWeight]
   199	  exact uniformDistribution_isProbability _
   200	
   201	/-- The line-point mixture has total probability one. -/
   202	theorem linePointDist_isProbability (L : LdParams) :
   203	    (linePointDist L).IsProbability := by
   204	  exact Distribution.mix_isProbability _ _ _
   205	    (aLinePointDist_isProbability L) (dLinePointDist_isProbability L)
   206	    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

  1080	$1$-dimensional), $V_{\dir{}}$ (which is $m$-dimensional), and
  1081	$V_{\rxpt},V_{\rzpt}$ (which are $1$-dimensional).

+        (fun k => x (f k)) + (fun k => y (f k)) := rfl
+    rw [h, map_add, clExtend_add hf]
+  map_smul' c x := by
+    show clExtend f (L (fun k => (c • x) (f k))) =
+      c • clExtend f (L (fun k => x (f k)))

+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: transport a conditionally linear syntax tree
+along an injective reindexing of registers; see `clExtend`.  Supports
+`def:cl-func`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:453-463`,
+paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`. -/
+private def clReindexTerm {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
+    {ell : ℕ} → CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell → CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) ell
+  | _, .zero => .zero
+  | _, .succ S₁ L₁ h rest =>
+      .succ (S₁.image f) (clReindexLinear hf L₁)
+        (by
+          intro x i hi
+          by_cases hex : ∃ k, f k = i
+          · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hex
+            have hk : k ∉ S₁ := fun hk => hi (Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hk)
+            show clExtend f (L₁ (fun j => x (f j))) (f k) = 0
+            rw [clExtend_apply hf]
+            exact h _ k hk
+          · show clExtend f (L₁ (fun j => x (f j))) i = 0
+            simp [clExtend, Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ hex])
+        (fun y => clReindexTerm hf (rest (fun k => y (f k))))
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the transported syntax tree is supported on
+any register containing the image of the original support. -/
+private theorem clReindexTerm_supportedOn {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
+    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}
+    (hf : Function.Injective f) :
+    ∀ {ell : ℕ} (t : CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell) (S : Finset κ)
+      (T : Finset ι), t.supportedOn S → S.image f ⊆ T →
+      (clReindexTerm hf t).supportedOn T := by
+  intro ell t
+  induction t with
+  | zero => intro S T _ _; trivial
+  | succ S₁ L₁ hL rest ih =>
+      intro S T hsupp hST
+      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hsupp
+      refine ⟨fun i hi => hST (Finset.image_subset_image h1 hi), fun y => ?_⟩
+      refine ih (fun k => y (f k)) (S \ S₁) (T \ S₁.image f) (h2 _) ?_
+      intro i hi
+      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
+      obtain ⟨hkS, hkS₁⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hk
+      refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hST (Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hkS), ?_⟩
+      intro hmem
+      obtain ⟨k', hk', hk'eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
+      exact hkS₁ (hf hk'eq ▸ hk')
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: evaluation commutes with the transport of a
+conditionally linear syntax tree along an injective reindexing. -/
+private theorem clReindexTerm_eval {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
+    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}
+    (hf : Function.Injective f) :
+    ∀ {ell : ℕ} (t : CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell) (x : ι → K),
+      CondLinearTerm.eval (clReindexTerm hf t) x =
+        clExtend f (CondLinearTerm.eval t (fun k => x (f k))) := by
+  intro ell t
+  induction t with
+  | zero => intro x; exact (clExtend_zero hf).symm
+  | succ S₁ L₁ hL rest ih =>
+      intro x
+      have hres : (fun k => coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x (f k)) =
+          coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)) := by
+        funext k
+        by_cases hk : k ∈ S₁
+        · have hmem : f k ∈ S₁.image f := Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hk
+          simp [coordinateRestriction, hk, hmem]
+        · have hni : f k ∉ S₁.image f := by
+            intro hmem
+            obtain ⟨k', hk', hk'eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
+            exact hk (hf hk'eq ▸ hk')
+          simp [coordinateRestriction, hk, hni]
+      have hhead : clReindexLinear hf L₁ (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) =
+          clExtend f (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)))) := by
+        show clExtend f (L₁ (fun k => coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x (f k))) = _
+        rw [hres]
+      have hcomp : (fun k => clReindexLinear hf L₁
+            (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) (f k)) =
+          L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k))) := by
+        rw [hhead]
+        exact clExtend_comp hf _
+      show clReindexLinear hf L₁ (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) +
+          CondLinearTerm.eval (clReindexTerm hf (rest
+            (fun k => clReindexLinear hf L₁
+              (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) (f k)))) x =
+        clExtend f (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k))) +
+          CondLinearTerm.eval
+            (rest (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)))))
+            (fun k => x (f k)))
+      rw [hcomp, ih _ x, hhead, ← clExtend_add hf]
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: conditional linearity is preserved by an
+injective reindexing of registers, the coordinates outside the image of the
+reindexing being set to zero. -/
+private theorem isCondLinearOn_reindex {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
+    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}
+    (hf : Function.Injective f) {ell : ℕ} {L : (κ → K) → (κ → K)}
+    (h : IsCondLinearOn K Finset.univ ell L) :
+    IsCondLinearOn K Finset.univ ell
+      (fun x => clExtend f (L (fun k => x (f k)))) := by
+  obtain ⟨t, hsupp, hval⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨clReindexTerm hf t,
+    clReindexTerm_supportedOn hf t Finset.univ Finset.univ hsupp
+      (Finset.subset_univ _), ?_⟩
+  funext x
+  rw [clReindexTerm_eval hf t x, hval]

+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the inclusion of the low-degree register index
+into the ambient Pauli register index selected by a basis.  It realizes the
+natural embedding of the range of the low-degree maps described in
+`def:pauli-question-distribution`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:285-329`,

+private def pauliLdIndex (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind) :
+    LdIndex P.toLdParams → PauliIndex P
+  | .inl (.inl j) =>
+      match W with
+      | .X => .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inl j))))
+      | .Z => .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inr j))))
+  | .inl (.inr _) => .inl (.inl (.inl (.inr ())))
+  | .inr j => .inl (.inl (.inr j))

+    Function.Injective (pauliLdIndex P W) := by
+  intro a b hab
+  cases W <;> rcases a with (j | u) | j <;> rcases b with (j' | u') | j' <;>
+    simp_all [pauliLdIndex]

+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: reading the low-degree register out of an
+ambient Pauli vector is restriction along `pauliLdIndex`; see
+`def:pauli-question-distribution`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:285-329`,

+    (z : PauliSpace P) :
+    pauliToLd P W z = fun k => z (pauliLdIndex P W k) := by
+  funext k
+  rcases k with (j | u) | j <;> cases W <;> rfl

+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: writing a low-degree vector into the ambient
+Pauli registers is extension along `pauliLdIndex`; see
+`def:pauli-question-distribution`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:285-329`,
+paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:964-1120`. -/
+private theorem embedLd_eq (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
+    (w : LdSpace P.toLdParams) :

+  have hf := pauliLdIndex_injective P W

+  · cases W
+    · exact (clExtend_apply hf w (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j))).symm
+    · exact (clExtend_eq_zero_of_not_mem _ w _ (by
+        rintro ((j' | u') | j') <;> simp [pauliLdIndex])).symm
+  · cases W
+    · exact (clExtend_eq_zero_of_not_mem _ w _ (by
+        rintro ((j' | u') | j') <;> simp [pauliLdIndex])).symm
+    · exact (clExtend_apply hf w (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j))).symm
+  · exact (clExtend_apply hf w (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))).symm
+  · exact (clExtend_apply hf w (Sum.inr j)).symm
+  · exact (clExtend_eq_zero_of_not_mem _ w _ (by
+      intro k
+      cases W <;> rcases k with (j' | u') | j' <;> simp [pauliLdIndex])).symm
+  · exact (clExtend_eq_zero_of_not_mem _ w _ (by
+      intro k
+      cases W <;> rcases k with (j' | u') | j' <;> simp [pauliLdIndex])).symm

   354	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: transport a conditionally linear syntax tree

   358	private def clReindexTerm {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
   359	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
   360	    {ell : ℕ} → CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell → CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) ell
   361	  | _, .zero => .zero
   362	  | _, .succ S₁ L₁ h rest =>
   363	      .succ (S₁.image f) (clReindexLinear hf L₁)
   364	        (by
   365	          intro x i hi
   366	          by_cases hex : ∃ k, f k = i
   367	          · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hex
   368	            have hk : k ∉ S₁ := fun hk => hi (Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hk)
   369	            show clExtend f (L₁ (fun j => x (f j))) (f k) = 0
   370	            rw [clExtend_apply hf]

   372	          · show clExtend f (L₁ (fun j => x (f j))) i = 0

   376	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the transported syntax tree is supported on
   377	any register containing the image of the original support. -/
   378	private theorem clReindexTerm_supportedOn {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
   379	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}
   380	    (hf : Function.Injective f) :
   381	    ∀ {ell : ℕ} (t : CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell) (S : Finset κ)
   382	      (T : Finset ι), t.supportedOn S → S.image f ⊆ T →
   383	      (clReindexTerm hf t).supportedOn T := by
   384	  intro ell t
   385	  induction t with
   386	  | zero => intro S T _ _; trivial
   387	  | succ S₁ L₁ hL rest ih =>
   388	      intro S T hsupp hST
   389	      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hsupp
   390	      refine ⟨fun i hi => hST (Finset.image_subset_image h1 hi), fun y => ?_⟩
   391	      refine ih (fun k => y (f k)) (S \ S₁) (T \ S₁.image f) (h2 _) ?_
   392	      intro i hi
   393	      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
   394	      obtain ⟨hkS, hkS₁⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hk
   395	      refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hST (Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hkS), ?_⟩
   396	      intro hmem
   397	      obtain ⟨k', hk', hk'eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
   398	      exact hkS₁ (hf hk'eq ▸ hk')

   400	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: evaluation commutes with the transport of a
   401	conditionally linear syntax tree along an injective reindexing. -/
   402	private theorem clReindexTerm_eval {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
   403	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}
   404	    (hf : Function.Injective f) :
   405	    ∀ {ell : ℕ} (t : CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell) (x : ι → K),
   406	      CondLinearTerm.eval (clReindexTerm hf t) x =
   407	        clExtend f (CondLinearTerm.eval t (fun k => x (f k))) := by
   408	  intro ell t
   409	  induction t with
   410	  | zero => intro x; exact (clExtend_zero hf).symm
   411	  | succ S₁ L₁ hL rest ih =>
   412	      intro x
   413	      have hres : (fun k => coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x (f k)) =
   414	          coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)) := by
   415	        funext k
   416	        by_cases hk : k ∈ S₁
   417	        · have hmem : f k ∈ S₁.image f := Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hk
   418	          simp [coordinateRestriction, hk, hmem]
   419	        · have hni : f k ∉ S₁.image f := by
   420	            intro hmem
   421	            obtain ⟨k', hk', hk'eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
   422	            exact hk (hf hk'eq ▸ hk')
   423	          simp [coordinateRestriction, hk, hni]
   424	      have hhead : clReindexLinear hf L₁ (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) =
   425	          clExtend f (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)))) := by
   426	        show clExtend f (L₁ (fun k => coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x (f k))) = _
   427	        rw [hres]
   428	      have hcomp : (fun k => clReindexLinear hf L₁
   429	            (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) (f k)) =
   430	          L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k))) := by
   431	        rw [hhead]
   432	        exact clExtend_comp hf _
   433	      show clReindexLinear hf L₁ (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) +
   434	          CondLinearTerm.eval (clReindexTerm hf (rest
   435	            (fun k => clReindexLinear hf L₁
   436	              (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) (f k)))) x =
   437	        clExtend f (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k))) +
   438	          CondLinearTerm.eval
   439	            (rest (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)))))
   440	            (fun k => x (f k)))
   441	      rw [hcomp, ih _ x, hhead, ← clExtend_add hf]

    12	and `fact:omega-anticomm-prob` in
    13	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:128-267`, with paper origin
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-95`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    18	
    19	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    20	
    21	noncomputable section
    22	
    23	/-- A tuple `(u_X,u_Z,r_X,r_Z)` over the fixed field model of an admissible
    24	Pauli-test parameter tuple. This is the tuple space of
    25	`def:anticommuting-tuple`, blueprint `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:128-148`, paper
    26	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-68`. -/
    27	abbrev PauliTuple (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
    28	  (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) ×
    29	    (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P
    30	
    31	/-- A Pauli tuple is anticommuting when its phase bit is nonzero. This is
    32	`def:anticommuting-tuple`, blueprint `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:128-148`, paper
    33	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-68`. -/
    34	def IsAnticommuting {P : AdmissibleParams} (ω : PauliTuple P) : Prop :=
    35	  gammaValue P ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2 ≠ 0
    36	
    37	/-- A Pauli tuple is commuting when its phase bit vanishes. This is the
    38	complementary case in `def:anticommuting-tuple`, blueprint
    39	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:128-148`, paper
    40	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-68`. -/
    41	def IsCommuting {P : AdmissibleParams} (ω : PauliTuple P) : Prop :=
    42	  gammaValue P ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2 = 0
    43	
    44	noncomputable instance (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    45	    DecidablePred (@IsAnticommuting P) := Classical.decPred _
    46	
    47	noncomputable instance (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    48	    DecidablePred (@IsCommuting P) := Classical.decPred _
    49	
    50	/-- The uniform probability of the anticommuting event. This is the first
    51	quantity in `fact:omega-anticomm-prob`, blueprint
    52	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`, paper
    53	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:70-77`. -/
    54	noncomputable def anticommProb (P : AdmissibleParams) : ℝ :=
    55	  ((Finset.univ.filter (@IsAnticommuting P)).card : ℝ) /
    56	    Fintype.card (PauliTuple P)
    57	
    58	/-- The complementary uniform probability of the commuting event in
    59	`fact:omega-anticomm-prob`, blueprint `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`,
    60	paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:70-77`. -/
    61	noncomputable def commProb (P : AdmissibleParams) : ℝ :=
    62	  ((Finset.univ.filter (@IsCommuting P)).card : ℝ) /
    63	    Fintype.card (PauliTuple P)

    65	/-! ### Auxiliary counting lemmas
    66	
    67	The declarations of this section are formalization-only auxiliaries for the
    68	proof of `fact:omega-anticomm-prob`, blueprint
    69	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-267`. They record the cardinalities used by the
    70	exact computation of the anticommuting probability. -/
    71	
    72	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the scalar carrier of an admissible parameter
    73	tuple has characteristic two, since it is an algebra over the two-element
    74	field. Blueprint `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`. -/
    75	private theorem pauliScalar_charTwo (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    76	    CharP (PauliScalar P) 2 :=
    77	  (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod 2) (PauliScalar P) 2).mp (ZMod.charP 2)
    78	
    79	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the scalar carrier of an admissible parameter
    80	tuple has exactly `q` elements. Blueprint
    81	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`. -/
    82	private theorem card_pauliScalar (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    83	    Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) = P.q :=
    84	  @FieldModel.card P.q P.model.toFieldModel
    85	
    86	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: an admissible field size is at least two.
    87	Blueprint `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`. -/
    88	private theorem two_le_q (P : AdmissibleParams) : 2 ≤ P.q := by
    89	  obtain ⟨k, hk, hq⟩ := P.hq
    90	  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hk
    91	  rw [hq, hj]
    92	  calc 2 = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
    93	    _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 * j + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    94	
    95	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: an admissible field size is either two or a
    96	multiple of eight, because its binary exponent is odd. Blueprint
    97	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`. -/
    98	private theorem q_eq_two_or_eight_dvd (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    99	    P.q = 2 ∨ 8 ∣ P.q := by
   100	  obtain ⟨k, hk, hq⟩ := P.hq
   101	  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hk
   102	  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hj0 | hj0
   103	  · left
   104	    rw [hq, hj, hj0]
   105	    norm_num
   106	  · right
   107	    refine ⟨2 ^ (2 * j + 1 - 3), ?_⟩
   108	    rw [hq, hj, show (8 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 3 by norm_num, ← pow_add]
   109	    congr 1
   110	    omega
   111	
   112	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: over a commutative ring of characteristic
   113	two, the inner product of two indicator vectors is the product of the
   114	coordinate sums `1 + x_i + z_i`. This is the product expansion used in the
   115	proof of `fact:omega-anticomm-prob`, blueprint
   116	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:196-235`. -/
   117	private theorem sum_indicatorVec_mul_indicatorVec {K : Type*} [CommRing K]
   118	    [CharP K 2] {m : ℕ} (x z : Fin m → K) :
   119	    ∑ y : Cube m, indicatorVec x y * indicatorVec z y
   120	      = ∏ i : Fin m, (1 + x i + z i) := by
   121	  have h2 : (2 : K) = 0 := CharTwo.two_eq_zero
   122	  have hev : ∀ (u : Fin m → K) (y : Cube m),
   123	      indicatorVec u y = ∏ i : Fin m, if y i then u i else 1 - u i := by
   124	    intro u y
   125	    simp [indicatorVec, indicatorPoly, apply_ite]
   126	  have hfac : ∀ i : Fin m,
   127	      ∑ b : Bool, ((if b then x i else 1 - x i) * (if b then z i else 1 - z i))
   128	        = 1 + x i + z i := by
   129	    intro i
   130	    have h1 :
   131	        ∑ b : Bool, ((if b then x i else 1 - x i) * (if b then z i else 1 - z i))
   132	          = x i * z i + (1 - x i) * (1 - z i) := by
   133	      rw [Fintype.sum_bool]
   134	      simp
   135	    rw [h1]
   136	    linear_combination (x i * z i - x i - z i) * h2
   137	  calc ∑ y : Cube m, indicatorVec x y * indicatorVec z y
   138	      = ∑ y : Cube m, ∏ i : Fin m,
   139	          ((if y i then x i else 1 - x i) * (if y i then z i else 1 - z i)) := by
   140	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   141	        intro y _
   142	        rw [hev x y, hev z y, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
   143	    _ = ∏ i : Fin m, ∑ b : Bool,
   144	          ((if b then x i else 1 - x i) * (if b then z i else 1 - z i)) := by
   145	        rw [Finset.prod_univ_sum, Fintype.piFinset_univ]
   146	    _ = ∏ i : Fin m, (1 + x i + z i) := Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => hfac i
   147	
   148	/-- The phase bit of a Pauli tuple is the trace of `r_Z r_X` times the product
   149	of the coordinate sums `1 + u_{X,i} + u_{Z,i}`. This is the closed form of
   150	`γ(ω)` derived in the proof of `fact:omega-anticomm-prob`, blueprint
   151	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:196-235`. -/
   152	private theorem gammaValue_eq_trace_prod (P : AdmissibleParams)
   153	    (uX uZ : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (rX rZ : PauliScalar P) :
   154	    gammaValue P uX uZ rX rZ =
   155	      fixedBinTrace P.model (rZ * (rX * ∏ i : Fin P.m, (1 + uX i + uZ i))) := by
   156	  haveI := pauliScalar_charTwo P
   157	  have hprod : (∑ y : Cube P.m, indicatorVec uX y * indicatorVec uZ y)
   158	      = ∏ i : Fin P.m, (1 + uX i + uZ i) :=
   159	    sum_indicatorVec_mul_indicatorVec uX uZ
   160	  unfold gammaValue
   161	  congr 1
   162	  rw [← hprod]
   163	  simp only [dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
   164	  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring
   165	
   166	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the field trace onto the two-element field
   167	takes each of its two values on exactly half of the scalars. This is the final
   168	step of the proof of `fact:omega-anticomm-prob`, blueprint
   169	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:236-249`. -/
   170	private theorem two_mul_card_trace_ne (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   171	    2 * (Finset.univ.filter
   172	        (fun a : PauliScalar P => fixedBinTrace P.model a ≠ 0)).card = P.q := by
   173	  classical
   174	  haveI := pauliScalar_charTwo P
   175	  have hK := card_pauliScalar P
   176	  have hadd : ∀ a c : PauliScalar P,
   177	      fixedBinTrace P.model (a + c)
   178	        = fixedBinTrace P.model a + fixedBinTrace P.model c := by
   179	    intro a c
   180	    simp [fixedBinTrace, binTrace]
   181	  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : PauliScalar P, fixedBinTrace P.model b = 1 := by
   182	    have hpos : 0 < P.model.basisDim := by
   183	      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := P.model.basisDimOdd
   184	      omega
   185	    refine ⟨P.model.basis ⟨0, hpos⟩ * P.model.basis ⟨0, hpos⟩, ?_⟩
   186	    simpa [fixedBinTrace, binTrace] using P.model.selfDual ⟨0, hpos⟩ ⟨0, hpos⟩
   187	  have hbb : b + b = 0 := CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero b
   188	  have himg :
   189	      (Finset.univ.filter
   190	          (fun a : PauliScalar P => fixedBinTrace P.model a = 0)).image (fun a => a + b)
   191	        = Finset.univ.filter
   192	            (fun a : PauliScalar P => ¬ (fixedBinTrace P.model a = 0)) := by
   193	    ext a
   194	    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
   195	    constructor
   196	    · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
   197	      rw [hadd, hc, hb]
   198	      simp
   199	    · intro ha
   200	      refine ⟨a + b, ?_, ?_⟩
   201	      · rw [hadd, hb]
   202	        have hone : fixedBinTrace P.model a = 1 := by
   203	          revert ha
   204	          generalize fixedBinTrace P.model a = t
   205	          revert t
   206	          decide
   207	        rw [hone]
   208	        decide
   209	      · rw [add_assoc, hbb, add_zero]
   210	  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun a : PauliScalar P => a + b) :=
   211	    fun _ _ h => by simpa using h
   212	  have hcard :
   213	      (Finset.univ.filter (fun a : PauliScalar P => fixedBinTrace P.model a = 0)).card
   214	        = (Finset.univ.filter
   215	            (fun a : PauliScalar P => ¬ (fixedBinTrace P.model a = 0))).card := by
   216	    rw [← himg, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj]
   217	  have hsplit :
   218	      (Finset.univ.filter (fun a : PauliScalar P => fixedBinTrace P.model a = 0)).card
   219	          + (Finset.univ.filter
   220	              (fun a : PauliScalar P => ¬ (fixedBinTrace P.model a = 0))).card
   221	        = Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) :=
   222	    Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
   223	  rw [hK] at hsplit
   224	  simp only [ne_eq]
   225	  omega

   227	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the number of Pauli tuples. Blueprint
   228	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`. -/
   229	private theorem card_pauliTuple (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   230	    Fintype.card (PauliTuple P) = P.q ^ P.m * (P.q ^ P.m * (P.q * P.q)) := by
   231	  have hK := card_pauliScalar P
   232	  simp [PauliTuple, Fintype.card_prod, hK]
   233	
   234	/-- Twice the number of anticommuting tuples is `q^{m+1}(q-1)^{m+1}`. This is
   235	the exact count established in the proof of `fact:omega-anticomm-prob`,
   236	blueprint `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:196-249`. -/
   237	private theorem two_mul_card_anticommuting (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   238	    2 * (Finset.univ.filter (@IsAnticommuting P)).card
   239	      = P.q ^ (P.m + 1) * (P.q - 1) ^ (P.m + 1) := by
   240	  classical
   241	  haveI := pauliScalar_charTwo P
   242	  have h2 : (2 : PauliScalar P) = 0 := CharTwo.two_eq_zero
   243	  have hK := card_pauliScalar P
   244	  have htr0 : fixedBinTrace P.model 0 = 0 := by
   245	    simp [fixedBinTrace, binTrace]
   246	  set N := (Finset.univ.filter
   247	    (fun a : PauliScalar P => fixedBinTrace P.model a ≠ 0)).card with hNdef
   248	  have hN : 2 * N = P.q := two_mul_card_trace_ne P
   249	  -- the innermost sum, over the second scalar coordinate
   250	  have hinner : ∀ c : PauliScalar P,
   251	      (∑ r : PauliScalar P, if fixedBinTrace P.model (r * c) ≠ 0 then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
   252	        = if c = 0 then 0 else N := by
   253	    intro c
   254	    by_cases hc : c = 0
   255	    · subst hc
   256	      simp [htr0]
   257	    · rw [if_neg hc, hNdef, Finset.card_filter]
   258	      exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.mulRight₀ c hc)
   259	        (fun r => if fixedBinTrace P.model (r * c) ≠ 0 then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
   260	        (fun a => if fixedBinTrace P.model a ≠ 0 then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
   261	        (fun r => rfl)
   262	  -- the sum over the first scalar coordinate
   263	  have hnzcard :
   264	      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : PauliScalar P => ¬ (x = 0))).card = P.q - 1 := by
   265	    have h1 : (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : PauliScalar P => x ≠ 0))
   266	        = Finset.univ.erase 0 := Finset.filter_ne' _ _
   267	    simp only [ne_eq] at h1
   268	    rw [h1, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.card_univ, hK]
   269	  have hmid : ∀ dd : PauliScalar P,
   270	      (∑ rX : PauliScalar P, if rX * dd = 0 then (0 : ℕ) else N)
   271	        = if dd = 0 then 0 else (P.q - 1) * N := by
   272	    intro dd
   273	    by_cases hd : dd = 0
   274	    · subst hd
   275	      simp
   276	    · rw [if_neg hd]
   277	      have hcong : ∀ rX : PauliScalar P,
   278	          (if rX * dd = 0 then (0 : ℕ) else N) = if rX = 0 then 0 else N := by
   279	        intro rX
   280	        by_cases hr : rX = 0
   281	        · simp [hr]
   282	        · rw [if_neg (by simpa using mul_ne_zero hr hd), if_neg hr]
   283	      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => hcong x), Finset.sum_ite]
   284	      simp [hnzcard]
   285	  -- the sum over the second point block
   286	  have hDcard : ∀ uX : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P,
   287	      (Finset.univ.filter (fun uZ : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
   288	        ¬ ((∏ i : Fin P.m, (1 + uX i + uZ i)) = 0))).card = (P.q - 1) ^ P.m := by
   289	    intro uX
   290	    have hset : (Finset.univ.filter (fun uZ : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
   291	        ¬ ((∏ i : Fin P.m, (1 + uX i + uZ i)) = 0)))
   292	        = Fintype.piFinset (fun i : Fin P.m => Finset.univ.erase (1 + uX i)) := by
   293	      ext uZ
   294	      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Fintype.mem_piFinset,
   295	        Finset.mem_erase, and_true]
   296	      constructor
   297	      · intro h i hi
   298	        refine h ?_
   299	        refine Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) ?_
   300	        rw [hi]
   301	        linear_combination (1 + uX i) * h2
   302	      · intro h hz
   303	        rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff] at hz
   304	        obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := hz
   305	        exact h i (by linear_combination hi - (1 + uX i) * h2)
   306	    rw [hset, Fintype.card_piFinset]
   307	    simp [Finset.card_erase_of_mem, Finset.card_univ, hK]
   308	  have houter : ∀ uX : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P,
   309	      (∑ uZ : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P,
   310	          if (∏ i : Fin P.m, (1 + uX i + uZ i)) = 0 then (0 : ℕ) else (P.q - 1) * N)
   311	        = (P.q - 1) ^ P.m * ((P.q - 1) * N) := by
   312	    intro uX
   313	    rw [Finset.sum_ite]
   314	    simp [hDcard uX]
   315	  have step1 : ∀ (uX uZ : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (rX : PauliScalar P),
   316	      (∑ rZ : PauliScalar P,
   317	          if IsAnticommuting ((uX, uZ, rX, rZ) : PauliTuple P) then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
   318	        = if rX * ∏ i : Fin P.m, (1 + uX i + uZ i) = 0 then 0 else N := by
   319	    intro uX uZ rX
   320	    have hcongr : ∀ rZ : PauliScalar P,
   321	        (if IsAnticommuting ((uX, uZ, rX, rZ) : PauliTuple P) then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
   322	          = if fixedBinTrace P.model
   323	              (rZ * (rX * ∏ i : Fin P.m, (1 + uX i + uZ i))) ≠ 0 then 1 else 0 := by
   324	      intro rZ
   325	      have hiff : IsAnticommuting ((uX, uZ, rX, rZ) : PauliTuple P)
   326	          ↔ fixedBinTrace P.model
   327	              (rZ * (rX * ∏ i : Fin P.m, (1 + uX i + uZ i))) ≠ 0 := by
   328	        unfold IsAnticommuting
   329	        rw [gammaValue_eq_trace_prod]
   330	      by_cases h : fixedBinTrace P.model
   331	          (rZ * (rX * ∏ i : Fin P.m, (1 + uX i + uZ i))) ≠ 0
   332	      · rw [if_pos (hiff.mpr h), if_pos h]
   333	      · rw [if_neg (fun hh => h (hiff.mp hh)), if_neg h]
   334	    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => hcongr x), hinner]
   335	  have hcount : (Finset.univ.filter (@IsAnticommuting P)).card
   336	      = P.q ^ P.m * ((P.q - 1) ^ P.m * ((P.q - 1) * N)) := by
   337	    rw [Finset.card_filter]
   338	    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   339	    calc (∑ uX : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P, ∑ uZ : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P,
   340	            ∑ rX : PauliScalar P, ∑ rZ : PauliScalar P,
   341	              (if IsAnticommuting ((uX, uZ, rX, rZ) : PauliTuple P) then (1 : ℕ) else 0))
   342	        = ∑ _uX : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P, (P.q - 1) ^ P.m * ((P.q - 1) * N) := by
   343	          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun uX _ => ?_
   344	          rw [← houter uX]
   345	          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun uZ _ => ?_
   346	          rw [← hmid (∏ i : Fin P.m, (1 + uX i + uZ i))]
   347	          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun rX _ => step1 uX uZ rX
   348	      _ = P.q ^ P.m * ((P.q - 1) ^ P.m * ((P.q - 1) * N)) := by
   349	          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul]
   350	          congr 1
   351	          simp [hK]
   352	  rw [hcount]
   353	  have hexpand : 2 * (P.q ^ P.m * ((P.q - 1) ^ P.m * ((P.q - 1) * N)))
   354	      = P.q ^ P.m * ((P.q - 1) ^ P.m * ((P.q - 1) * (2 * N))) := by ring
   355	  rw [hexpand, hN, pow_succ, pow_succ]
   356	  ring

   358	/-- The anticommuting and commuting events partition the tuple space.
   359	Blueprint `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`. -/
   360	private theorem card_comm_add_card_anticomm (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   361	    (Finset.univ.filter (@IsCommuting P)).card
   362	      + (Finset.univ.filter (@IsAnticommuting P)).card
   363	      = Fintype.card (PauliTuple P) := by
   364	  classical
   365	  have hfil : (Finset.univ.filter (@IsAnticommuting P))
   366	      = Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : PauliTuple P => ¬ (@IsCommuting P ω)) := by
   367	    refine Finset.filter_congr ?_
   368	    intro ω _
   369	    simp [IsAnticommuting, IsCommuting]
   370	  rw [hfil, ← Finset.card_univ]
   371	  exact Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
   372	
   373	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the tuple space is nonempty and finite.
   374	Blueprint `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`. -/
   375	private theorem card_pauliTuple_pos (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   376	    0 < Fintype.card (PauliTuple P) := by
   377	  have hq : 0 < P.q := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (two_le_q P)
   378	  rw [card_pauliTuple P]
   379	  exact Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos hq _) (Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos hq _) (Nat.mul_pos hq hq))

   381	/-! ### The exact anticommuting probability -/
   382	
   383	/-- Exact anticommuting probability from `fact:omega-anticomm-prob`, blueprint
   384	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`; its derivation replaces the erroneous
   385	Schwartz--Zippel argument at paper
   386	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:79-93`. -/
   387	theorem anticommProb_eq (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   388	    anticommProb P = (1 - (P.q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (P.m + 1) / 2 := by
   389	  have hq2 : 2 ≤ P.q := two_le_q P

   132	\begin{definition}[Commuting and anticommuting tuples]
   133		\label{def:anticommuting-tuple}

   141		For a tuple
   142		$\omega = (u_X, u_Z, r_X, r_Z) \in (\F_q^m)^2 \times (\F_q)^2$, let
   143		\[
   144			\gamma(\omega) \,=\, \tr\big( (r_X \cdot \mathrm{ind}_m(u_X)) \cdot (r_Z \cdot \mathrm{ind}_m(u_Z)) \big)\,,

   147		vector $\mathrm{ind}_m(u_W) \in \F_q^{M}$, the middle $\cdot$ is the
   148		$\F_q$-inner product of two vectors in $\F_q^{M}$, and
   149		$\tr = \tr_{q \to 2}$. The tuple $\omega$ is called \emph{anticommuting}
   150		if $\gamma(\omega) \neq 0$, and \emph{commuting} if $\gamma(\omega) = 0$.

   155	$\tau^Z(r_Z \cdot \mathrm{ind}_m(u_Z))$ commute

   178		$(\F_q^m)^2 \times (\F_q)^2$ is anticommuting with probability exactly

   181		\]

   183		$\frac12$. In particular, if $m \leq q$, then $\omega$ is anticommuting
   184		with probability at least $2^{-4}$ and commuting with probability at
   185		least $\frac12$. If $m, d \geq 1$, then the probability that $\omega$ is
   186		anticommuting is at least
   187		\[
   188			(1 - q^{-m}) \cdot (1 - q^{-1}) \cdot \Big(1 - \frac{md}{q}\Big) \cdot \frac{1}{2}

   192		$\big(1 - \frac{3md}{q}\big) \cdot \frac{1}{2}$.

   196		\uses{def:low-degree-encoding, def:indicator-vector, def:admissible-size, def:binary-representation, lem:downsize_field, lem:one}
   197		By the definition of the indicator vector
   198		(Definition~\ref{def:indicator-vector}), expanding the product over the
   199		coordinates $i \in \{1, \dots, m\}$ into a sum over $y \in \{0,1\}^m$
   200		gives
   201		\[
   202			\mathrm{ind}_m(u_X) \cdot \mathrm{ind}_m(u_Z)
   203			\,=\, \sum_{y \in \{0,1\}^m} \mathrm{ind}_{m,y}(u_X)\, \mathrm{ind}_{m,y}(u_Z)
   204			\,=\, \prod_{i=1}^{m} \big( u_{X,i}\, u_{Z,i} + (1 - u_{X,i})(1 - u_{Z,i}) \big)\,,
   205		\]
   206		and since $\F_q$ has characteristic $2$, the $i$-th factor equals
   207		$1 + u_{X,i} + u_{Z,i}$. Hence
   208		\[
   209			\gamma(\omega) \,=\, \tr\Big( (r_X r_Z) \cdot \prod_{i=1}^{m} (1 + u_{X,i} + u_{Z,i}) \Big)\,.
   210		\]
   211		For any fixed $u_X$, the $m$ factors $1 + u_{X,i} + u_{Z,i}$ are
   212		independent and uniformly distributed in $\F_q$ over the choice of
   213		$u_Z$, so all of them are nonzero with probability $(1-q^{-1})^m$;
   214		independently, $r_X \neq 0$ with probability $1 - q^{-1}$. If $r_X = 0$
   215		or some factor vanishes, then $\gamma(\omega) = 0$. Otherwise, over the
   216		uniform choice of $r_Z$, the argument of the trace is a uniformly random
   217		element of $\F_q$. Since $q = 2^k$ is admissible, the trace of an
   218		element of $\F_q$ equals the coordinate sum of its binary
   219		representation: writing $\kappa$ for the binary representation with
   220		respect to the fixed self-dual normal basis
   221		(Definition~\ref{def:binary-representation}), item~2 of
   222		Lemma~\ref{lem:downsize_field} gives
   223		$\tr(c) = \tr(c \cdot 1) = \kappa(c) \cdot \kappa(1)$, and $\kappa(1)$
   224		is the all-ones vector by Lemma~\ref{lem:one}. As $\kappa$ is a
   225		bijection onto $\F_2^k$, a uniformly random element of $\F_q$ has trace
   226		$0$ with probability exactly $\frac12$. Combining, the probability that
   227		$\gamma(\omega) \neq 0$ is exactly $(1-q^{-1})^{m+1} \cdot \frac12$, and
   228		the probability that $\omega$ is commuting is the complement, which is
   229		at least $\frac12$.
   230	
   231		If $m \leq q$, then
   232		$(1-q^{-1})^{m+1} \geq (1-q^{-1})^{q+1} = (1-q^{-1})^{q} \cdot (1-q^{-1})$,
   233		a product of two positive functions of $q$ that are nondecreasing for
   234		$q \geq 2$, so it is minimized at $q = 2$, where it equals $2^{-3}$;
   235		hence the anticommuting probability is at least $2^{-4}$.
   236	
   237		Finally, suppose $m, d \geq 1$, and consider the first inequality of
   238		the display, which bounds the anticommuting probability from below.
   239		If $md > q$, that lower bound is negative --- it is the product of
   240		the positive factors $1 - q^{-m}$, $1 - q^{-1}$, and $\frac12$ with
   241		the negative factor $1 - md/q$ --- so the anticommuting probability,
   242		being nonnegative, exceeds it. If $md \leq q$, then by Bernoulli's
   243		inequality
   244		$(1-q^{-1})^{m} \geq 1 - m/q \geq 1 - md/q \geq (1-q^{-m})(1-md/q)$,
   245		where the last step multiplies the nonnegative quantity $1 - md/q$
   246		by $1 - q^{-m} \leq 1$; multiplying by $1 - q^{-1}$ shows that the
   247		anticommuting probability is at least the first displayed bound. For
   248		the second inequality of the display, expanding the product shows
   249		that $(1-q^{-m})(1-q^{-1})(1-md/q)$ exceeds
   250		$1 - q^{-m} - q^{-1} - md/q$ by
   251		$q^{-m-1} + \frac{md}{q} \big( q^{-m} + q^{-1} - q^{-m-1} \big)$,
   252		a sum of nonnegative terms whatever the sign of $1 - md/q$; since
   253		$md \geq 1$ gives $q^{-m} \leq q^{-1} \leq md/q$, the product is
   254		therefore at least $1 - 3md/q$.
   255		The commuting probability is at least
   256		$\frac12 \geq \big(1 - \frac{3md}{q}\big) \cdot \frac12$.
   257	\end{proof}

  1495	We specify a canonical setting of the parameter tuple $\qldparams$ as a function
  1496	of an integer $R$.

  1498	``introspection'' section (\Cref{sec:introspection}).

  1500	functions of the Pauli basis test corresponding to the parameter tuple

  1502	
  1503	\begin{definition}[Canonical parameters of the Pauli basis test]
  1504	  \label{def:introparams}
  1505	  Let $a,b$ be the universal constants specified in Theorem~\ref{thm:pauli}.
  1506	  Let $c$ denote the smallest even integer that is at least $(b + a)/b$.
  1507	  For all integers $R \geq 4$, define the tuple $\introparams(R) = (q,m,d)$
  1508	  where
  1509	  \begin{itemize}
  1510	  	\item $q = 2^k$ for $k = c \lceil  \log \log R  \rceil + 1$.
  1511		\item $m = 2^j$ where $2^j \leq c \lceil \log R \rceil + 1 < 2^{j+1}$. 
  1512		\item $d = 1$. 
  1513	  \end{itemize}
  1514	\end{definition}
  1515	
  1516	Intuitively, this choice of parameters is such that the Pauli basis test
  1517	certifies the presence of an $M=2^m$-qudit EPR state (of local dimension $q$), or
  1518	equivalently an $M\log q$-qubit EPR state.
  1519	
  1520	\begin{lemma}
  1521	  \label{lem:delta-bound}
  1522	 For all integers $R \geq 4$, the parameter tuple $\introparams(R) = (q,m,d)$ is
  1523	  admissible (see Definition~\ref{def:admissible}), satisfies $2^m \geq R$, and furthermore there exist
  1524	  universal constants $a'\geq 1$ and $0 < b' \leq 1$ such that the function
  1525	  $\delta_\qld(\eps, m, d, q)$ from Theorem~\ref{thm:pauli} is at most
  1526	   \[
  1527	   	a' ( \log(R)^{a'} \cdot \eps^{b'} + \log(R)^{-b'}) \;.
  1528		\]
  1529	\end{lemma}
  1530	
  1531	\begin{proof}
  1532	  We verify the admissibility of $\introparams(R)$ first: the field size $q =
  1533	  2^k$ is admissible because $k$ is odd. We have $m | q$ because for all $R \geq 4$ we have  
  1534	  \[
  1535	  	2^j \leq 2 c \lceil \log R \rceil \leq 2 \log^c R \leq 2^k~.
  1536	  \]
  1537		Next, we show that $R \leq 2^m$. Since $m = 2^j \geq (c/2) \log R$, we have that
  1538		\[
  1539			2^m \geq R^{c/2} \geq R
  1540		\]
  1541		where we used that $c \geq 2$. 
  1542	
  1543	Finally, we show the desired bound on the error function $\delta_\qld(\eps,m,d,q)$. First, observe that $2^{-bmd} \leq q^{-b}$ because $k \leq m$.
  1544	  Note that for $R \geq 2$, we have $m \leq 2c \log R$, and furthermore $q =
  1545	  2^k \geq \log^c R$.

  1547	\begin{align*}
  1548	  	\delta_\qld(\eps,m,d,q)
  1549	    & = a (md)^a (\eps^b + q^{-b} + 2^{-bmd}) \tag{by Theorem~\ref{thm:pauli}}  \\
  1550	    & \leq a (md)^a (\eps^b + 2q^{-b}) \tag{because  $2^{-bmd} \leq q^{-b}$}  \\
  1551	    & = a (m)^a (\eps^b + 2q^{-b}) \tag{because  $d=1$}  \\

  1553	    & \leq a (2c)^a \log^{a} (R) ( \eps^{b} + 2(\log R)^{-cb}) \tag{because  $q \geq \log^c R$}\\
  1554	    & \leq 2a (2c)^a \log^{a} (R) ( \eps^{b} + (\log R)^{-cb}) \\

  1557	      + (\log R)^{-b} \right) \tag{because  $cb - a \geq b \geq 0$}\\
  1558	    & \leq a' ( (\log R)^{a'} \eps^{b} + (\log R)^{-b}),
  1559	  \end{align*}
  1560	  where $a'$ is defined as the quantity $2a(2c)^a$.
  1561	This completes the proof of the lemma.
  1562	\end{proof}

    79	/-- The register index used by the low-degree game (`def:ld-game`, blueprint

    91	/-- The point coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
    92	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.

    94	def LdSpace.point {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=

    96	
    97	/-- The shared scalar coordinate of an ambient low-degree vector in
    98	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    99	-/
   100	def LdSpace.seed {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : ScalarQ P :=

   104	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.

   106	def LdSpace.direction {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=

   108	
   109	/-- The integer-coordinate map `χ` from the fixed field representation.  This
   110	is `eq:chi-func` in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   111	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   112	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   113	-/
   114	noncomputable def chiIndex (P : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ P) : Fin P.m := by
   115	  letI : NeZero P.m := ⟨by
   116	    exact Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.hm)⟩
   117	  exact Fin.ofNat P.m ((binaryRepresentation P.model s).val / (P.q / P.m))
   118	
   119	/-- The projection used in the diagonal-line map zeroes coordinates before the
   120	chosen index and retains the suffix of the direction vector.  This is the
   121	prefix restriction in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   122	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   123	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   124	-/
   125	def prefixProjection {P : LdParams} (i : Fin P.m) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
   126	    Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
   127	  fun j => if j.val < i.val then 0 else v j
   128	
   129	/-- The point CL map, retaining the point block and clearing the auxiliary
   130	blocks.  It is the map `L_point` of `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   131	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   132	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   133	-/
   134	def ldPointCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   135	  fun i => match i with
   136	  | .inl (.inl j) => z (.inl (.inl j))
   137	  | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   138	  | .inr _ => 0
   139	
   140	/-- The affine-line CL map.  The direction block is put through the canonical
   141	line representative map from `def:line-representative`, while the point block
   142	is retained (blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`; paper
   143	origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   144	-/
   145	noncomputable def ldALineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   146	  let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
   147	  let rep := lineRepMap (coordinateDirection i)
   148	  fun i => match i with
   149	  | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
   150	  | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
   151	  | .inr _ => 0
   152	
   153	/-- The diagonal-line CL map, using the same canonical representative interface
   154	for the direction block.  This is the `L_DLine` clause of
   155	`def:ld-question-distribution` (blueprint
   156	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`; paper origin
   157	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   158	-/
   159	noncomputable def ldDLineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   160	  let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
   161	  let direction := prefixProjection i (z.direction)
   162	  let rep := lineRepMap direction
   163	  fun i => match i with
   164	  | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
   165	  | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
   166	  | .inr j => direction j
   167	
   168	/-- Dispatch the three low-degree CL maps by question type.  This is the typed
   169	construction in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   170	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   171	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   172	-/
   173	noncomputable def ldCL (P : LdParams) : LdType → LdSpace P → LdSpace P
   174	  | .point => ldPointCL P
   175	  | .aline => ldALineCL P
   176	  | .dline => ldDLineCL P

   178	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the shared scalar
   179	coordinate of the ambient low-degree space.  It is the first register in the
   180	concatenation exhibiting the conditional-linearity levels asserted in
   181	`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   182	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   183	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`. -/
   184	private def ldSeedRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
   185	  {Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())}

   187	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the point coordinates
   188	of the ambient low-degree space; see `ldSeedRegister`. -/
   189	private def ldPointRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
   190	  Finset.univ.image fun j : Fin P.m => (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j) : LdIndex P)

   192	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the direction
   193	coordinates of the ambient low-degree space; see `ldSeedRegister`. -/
   194	private def ldDirectionRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
   195	  Finset.univ.image fun j : Fin P.m => (Sum.inr j : LdIndex P)

   197	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map retaining the shared scalar
   198	coordinate and clearing every other coordinate. -/
   199	private def ldSeedLinear (P : LdParams) :
   200	    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
   201	  toFun x := fun i =>
   202	    match i with
   203	    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
   204	    | .inl (.inr _) => x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))
   205	    | .inr _ => 0
   206	  map_add' x y := by
   207	    funext i
   208	    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> simp
   209	  map_smul' c x := by
   210	    funext i
   211	    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> simp
   212	
   213	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map sending the point block to its
   214	canonical line representative in the fixed direction `v` and clearing every
   215	other coordinate. -/
   216	private noncomputable def ldPointCLLinear (P : LdParams) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
   217	    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
   218	  toFun x := fun i =>
   219	    match i with
   220	    | .inl (.inl j) => lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point x) j
   221	    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   222	    | .inr _ => 0
   223	  map_add' x y := by
   224	    funext i
   225	    rcases i with (j | u) | j
   226	    · change lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point (x + y)) j = _
   227	      have hpoint : LdSpace.point (x + y) = LdSpace.point x + LdSpace.point y := rfl
   228	      rw [hpoint, map_add]
   229	      rfl
   230	    · simp
   231	    · simp
   232	  map_smul' c x := by
   233	    funext i
   234	    rcases i with (j | u) | j
   235	    · change lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point (c • x)) j = _
   236	      have hpoint : LdSpace.point (c • x) = c • LdSpace.point x := rfl
   237	      rw [hpoint, map_smul]
   238	      rfl
   239	    · simp
   240	    · simp
   241	
   242	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map zeroing the first `i`
   243	coordinates of the direction block and clearing every other coordinate. -/
   244	private def ldDirectionCLLinear (P : LdParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
   245	    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
   246	  toFun x := fun k =>
   247	    match k with
   248	    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
   249	    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   250	    | .inr j => prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction x) j
   251	  map_add' x y := by
   252	    funext k
   253	    rcases k with (j | u) | j
   254	    · simp
   255	    · simp
   256	    · change prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction (x + y)) j =
   257	        prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction x) j +
   258	          prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction y) j
   259	      by_cases h : j.val < i.val
   260	      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_pos h, add_zero]
   261	      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_neg h]
   262	        rfl
   263	  map_smul' c x := by
   264	    funext k
   265	    rcases k with (j | u) | j
   266	    · simp
   267	    · simp
   268	    · change prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction (c • x)) j =
   269	        c • prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction x) j
   270	      by_cases h : j.val < i.val
   271	      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_pos h, smul_zero]
   272	      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_neg h]
   273	        rfl

   275	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the shared-scalar map vanishes
   276	outside the scalar register. -/
   277	private theorem ldSeedLinear_supported (P : LdParams) :
   278	    ∀ (x : LdSpace P) (i : LdIndex P), i ∉ ldSeedRegister P →
   279	      ldSeedLinear P x i = 0 := by
   280	  intro x i hi
   281	  rcases i with (j | u) | j
   282	  · rfl
   283	  · cases u
   284	    exact absurd (Finset.mem_singleton_self _) hi
   285	  · rfl

   287	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the canonical-representative map
   288	vanishes outside the point register. -/
   289	private theorem ldPointCLLinear_supported (P : LdParams) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
   290	    ∀ (x : LdSpace P) (i : LdIndex P), i ∉ ldPointRegister P →
   291	      ldPointCLLinear P v x i = 0 := by
   292	  intro x i hi
   293	  rcases i with (j | u) | j
   294	  · exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)) hi
   295	  · rfl
   296	  · rfl

   303	  intro x k hk
   304	  rcases k with (j | u) | j
   305	  · rfl
   306	  · rfl
   307	  · exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)) hk

   329	      (Finset.univ \ ldSeedRegister P) \ ldDirectionRegister P := by

   334	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: restricting to the scalar register

   355	    LdSpace.direction (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x) =

   362	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: a two-level representation of the
   363	affine-line map as a conditionally linear function. -/
   364	private noncomputable def ldALineTerm (P : LdParams) :
   365	    CondLinearTerm (ScalarQ P) (ι := LdIndex P) 2 :=
   366	  .succ (ldSeedRegister P) (ldSeedLinear P) (ldSeedLinear_supported P)
   367	    fun y =>
   368	      .succ (ldPointRegister P)
   369	        (ldPointCLLinear P (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed y))))
   370	        (ldPointCLLinear_supported P _)
   371	        fun _ => .zero

   373	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: a three-level representation of the
   374	diagonal-line map as a conditionally linear function. -/
   375	private noncomputable def ldDLineTerm (P : LdParams) :
   376	    CondLinearTerm (ScalarQ P) (ι := LdIndex P) 3 :=
   377	  .succ (ldSeedRegister P) (ldSeedLinear P) (ldSeedLinear_supported P)
   378	    fun y =>
   379	      .succ (ldDirectionRegister P)
   380	        (ldDirectionCLLinear P (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed y)))
   381	        (ldDirectionCLLinear_supported P _)
   382	        fun w =>
   383	          .succ (ldPointRegister P)
   384	            (ldPointCLLinear P (LdSpace.direction w))
   385	            (ldPointCLLinear_supported P _)
   386	            fun _ => .zero

   388	/-- The conditional-linearity level of the affine-line map.  This is
   389	`lem:ld-aline-level`, the level-2 assertion in `def:ld-question-distribution`;
   390	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:61-71`, paper
   391	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   392	-/
   393	theorem isCondLinear_ldALineCL (P : LdParams) :
   394	    IsCondLinearOn (ScalarQ P) Finset.univ 2 (ldALineCL P) := by
   395	  refine ⟨ldALineTerm P, ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, fun _ =>
   396	    ⟨ldPointRegister_subset_sdiff_seed P, fun _ => trivial⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   397	  funext x
   398	  have hseed :
   399	      LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x)) =
   400	        LdSpace.seed x := coordinateRestriction_seed P x
   401	  have hpoint : LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) =
   402	      LdSpace.point x := coordinateRestriction_point P x
   403	  have hval :
   404	      CondLinearTerm.eval (ldALineTerm P) x =
   405	        ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
   406	          (ldPointCLLinear P (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)))
   407	            (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0) := by
   408	    change ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
   409	        (ldPointCLLinear P
   410	            (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P
   411	              (LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x)))))
   412	            (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0) = _
   413	    rw [hseed]
   414	  rw [hval]
   415	  funext i
   416	  rcases i with (j | u) | j
   417	  · change (0 : ScalarQ P) +
   418	        (lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)))
   419	          (LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x)) j + 0) =
   420	      lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)))
   421	        (LdSpace.point x) j
   422	    rw [hpoint, zero_add, add_zero]
   423	  · change coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())) +
   424	        ((0 : ScalarQ P) + 0) = x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))
   425	    rw [coordinateRestriction_seed, add_zero, add_zero]
   426	  · change (0 : ScalarQ P) + ((0 : ScalarQ P) + 0) = 0
   427	    rw [add_zero, add_zero]
   428	
   429	/-- The conditional-linearity level of the diagonal-line map.  This is
   430	`lem:ld-dline-level`, the level-3 assertion in `def:ld-question-distribution`;
   431	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:73-83`, paper origin
   432	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   433	-/
   434	theorem isCondLinear_ldDLineCL (P : LdParams) :
   435	    IsCondLinearOn (ScalarQ P) Finset.univ 3 (ldDLineCL P) := by
   436	  refine ⟨ldDLineTerm P, ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, fun _ =>
   437	    ⟨ldDirectionRegister_subset_sdiff_seed P, fun _ =>
   438	      ⟨ldPointRegister_subset_sdiff_seed_direction P, fun _ => trivial⟩⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   439	  funext x
   440	  have hseed :
   441	      LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x)) =
   442	        LdSpace.seed x := coordinateRestriction_seed P x
   443	  have hpoint : LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) =
   444	      LdSpace.point x := coordinateRestriction_point P x
   445	  have hdir :
   446	      LdSpace.direction
   447	          (ldDirectionCLLinear P (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x))
   448	            (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x)) =
   449	        prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x) := by
   450	    funext j
   451	    change prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x))
   452	        (LdSpace.direction (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x)) j = _
   453	    rw [coordinateRestriction_direction]
   454	  have hval :
   455	      CondLinearTerm.eval (ldDLineTerm P) x =
   456	        ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
   457	          (ldDirectionCLLinear P (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x))
   458	              (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x) +
   459	            (ldPointCLLinear P
   460	                (prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x))
   461	                (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0)) := by
   462	    change ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
   463	        (ldDirectionCLLinear P
   464	            (chiIndex P
   465	              (LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x))))
   466	            (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x) +
   467	          (ldPointCLLinear P
   468	              (LdSpace.direction
   469	                (ldDirectionCLLinear P
   470	                  (chiIndex P
   471	                    (LdSpace.seed
   472	                      (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x))))
   473	                  (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x)))
   474	              (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0)) = _
   475	    rw [hseed, hdir]
   476	  rw [hval]
   477	  funext i
   478	  rcases i with (j | u) | j
   479	  · change (0 : ScalarQ P) + ((0 : ScalarQ P) +
   480	        (lineRepMap

   513	/-- The coefficient-tuple answer alphabet of the low-degree game.  Polynomial
   514	answers are representatives with exactly the coefficient lengths printed in
   515	the paper, as required by `def:ld-win-predicate` (blueprint
   516	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`; paper
   517	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   518	-/
   519	inductive LdAnswer (P : LdParams) where
   520	  | pointVals (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P)
   521	  | alinePolys (a : Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   522	  | dlinePolys (a : Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   523	  deriving DecidableEq
   524	
   525	/-- A finite sum code used only to provide the answer alphabet's `Fintype`
   526	instance; the public constructors are those of `def:ld-win-predicate`,
   527	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   528	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   529	-/
   530	abbrev LdAnswerCode (P : LdParams) :=
   531	  (Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) ⊕
   532	    ((Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P) ⊕
   533	      (Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P))
   534	
   535	/-- The constructor-preserving code equivalence for `LdAnswer` (Lean-only
   536	finite-carrier infrastructure for `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   537	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   538	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   539	-/
   540	noncomputable def ldAnswerEquiv (P : LdParams) :
   541	    LdAnswer P ≃ LdAnswerCode P where
   542	  toFun
   543	    | .pointVals a => .inl a
   544	    | .alinePolys a => .inr (.inl a)
   545	    | .dlinePolys a => .inr (.inr a)
   546	  invFun
   547	    | .inl a => .pointVals a
   548	    | .inr (.inl a) => .alinePolys a
   549	    | .inr (.inr a) => .dlinePolys a
   550	  left_inv := by intro x; cases x <;> rfl
   551	  right_inv := by
   552	    intro x
   553	    cases x with
   554	    | inl a => rfl
   555	    | inr x =>
   556	        cases x with
   557	        | inl a => rfl
   558	        | inr a => rfl

   560	instance (P : LdParams) : Inhabited (LdAnswer P) :=
   561	  ⟨.pointVals (fun _ => 0)⟩
   562	
   563	noncomputable instance (P : LdParams) : Fintype (LdAnswer P) :=
   564	  Fintype.ofEquiv (LdAnswerCode P) (ldAnswerEquiv P).symm

   566	/-- Evaluation of a coefficient tuple at a field element.  This is the
   567	representative convention used by the line answers in `def:ld-win-predicate`,
   568	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   569	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   570	-/
   571	def evalCoefficient {K : Type*} [Semiring K] {n : ℕ}
   572	    (c : Fin n → K) (t : K) : K :=
   573	  ∑ i : Fin n, c i * t ^ i.val
   574	
   575	/-- Check that an answer has the constructor prescribed by its question type;
   576	Lean encoding of the rejection clause in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   577	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   578	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   579	-/
   580	def validLdAnswer {P : LdParams} (t : LdType) (a : LdAnswer P) : Bool :=
   581	  match t, a with
   582	  | .point, .pointVals _ => true
   583	  | .aline, .alinePolys _ => true
   584	  | .dline, .dlinePolys _ => true
   585	  | _, _ => false
   586	
   587	/-- The axis-parallel line/point relation in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   588	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   589	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   590	-/
   591	def alinePointCondition (P : LdParams) (line point : LdSpace P)
   592	    (f : Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   593	    (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) : Prop :=
   594	  -- Universal quantification follows the zero-direction convention in
   595	  -- `rem:ld-win-zero-direction`.
   596	  ∀ t : ScalarQ P,
   597	    point.point = line.point + t • coordinateDirection (chiIndex P line.seed) →
   598	      ∀ j : Fin P.k, evalCoefficient (f j) t = a j
   599	
   600	/-- The diagonal line/point relation in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   601	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   602	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   603	-/
   604	def dlinePointCondition (P : LdParams) (line point : LdSpace P)
   605	    (f : Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   606	    (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) : Prop :=
   607	  ∀ t : ScalarQ P,
   608	    point.point = line.point + t • line.direction →
   609	      ∀ j : Fin P.k, evalCoefficient (f j) t = a j
   610	
   611	/-- The low-degree consistency predicate, rejecting answers of the wrong
   612	constructor shape.  This is `def:ld-win-predicate` in
   613	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   614	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   615	-/
   616	noncomputable def ldWinPredicate (P : LdParams) :
   617	    LdQuestion P → LdQuestion P → LdAnswer P → LdAnswer P → Bool :=
   618	  open Classical in
   619	  fun (tA, xA) (tB, xB) a b =>
   620	      if validLdAnswer tA a && validLdAnswer tB b then

   113	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: every fiber of the coordinate index has
   114	exactly `q / m` elements.  This is the balance property used in
   115	`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper
   116	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`. -/
   117	private theorem card_chiIndex_fiber (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   118	    ((Finset.univ : Finset (ScalarQ L)).filter fun s => chiIndex L s = i).card
   119	      = L.q / L.m := by
   120	  have hq : 0 < L.q := ldParams_q_pos L
   121	  have hqk : L.m * (L.q / L.m) = L.q := Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd
   122	  have hkpos : 0 < L.q / L.m := by
   123	    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (L.q / L.m) with h | h
   124	    · rw [h, Nat.mul_zero] at hqk
   125	      omega
   126	    · exact h
   127	  have hstep1 :
   128	      ((Finset.univ : Finset (ScalarQ L)).filter fun s => chiIndex L s = i).card
   129	        = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.q)).filter
   130	            fun n => (n.val / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val).card := by
   131	    refine Finset.card_equiv (binaryRepresentation L.model) fun s => ?_
   132	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, chiIndex_eq_iff]
   133	  have hstep2 :
   134	      ((Finset.range L.q).filter fun t => (t / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val)
   135	        = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.q)).filter
   136	            fun n => (n.val / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val).image Fin.val := by
   137	    ext t
   138	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_image,
   139	      Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
   140	    constructor
   141	    · rintro ⟨ht, hP⟩
   142	      exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hP, rfl⟩
   143	    · rintro ⟨n, hP, rfl⟩
   144	      exact ⟨n.isLt, hP⟩
   145	  have hstep3 :
   146	      ((Finset.range L.q).filter fun t => (t / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val)
   147	        = Finset.Ico (i.val * (L.q / L.m)) (i.val * (L.q / L.m) + L.q / L.m) := by
   148	    ext t
   149	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ico]
   150	    constructor
   151	    · rintro ⟨htq, hP⟩
   152	      have hlt : t / (L.q / L.m) < L.m := by
   153	        rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hkpos]
   154	        omega
   155	      have hdiv : t / (L.q / L.m) = i.val := by
   156	        rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt] at hP
   157	      have hle : t / (L.q / L.m) * (L.q / L.m) ≤ t := Nat.div_mul_le_self t _
   158	      have hupper : t < (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m) := by
   159	        rw [← Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hkpos, hdiv]
   160	        omega
   161	      have hexp : (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m)
   162	          = i.val * (L.q / L.m) + L.q / L.m := by ring
   163	      rw [hdiv] at hle
   164	      omega
   165	    · rintro ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
   166	      have hexp : (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m)
   167	          = i.val * (L.q / L.m) + L.q / L.m := by ring
   168	      have hdiv : t / (L.q / L.m) = i.val := by
   169	        have h1 : i.val ≤ t / (L.q / L.m) := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hkpos).mpr hlo
   170	        have h2 : t / (L.q / L.m) < i.val + 1 := by
   171	          rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hkpos]
   172	          omega
   173	        omega
   174	      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   175	      · have hbound : (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m) ≤ L.m * (L.q / L.m) :=

   177	        omega

   180	      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.q)).filter
   181	        fun n => (n.val / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val) Fin.val_injective,

   263	        = (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map LdSpace.point := by
   264	      change ((((uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map
   265	          fun z => (ldDLineCL L z, ldPointCL L z)).map
   266	          fun s => (dLineDescOf L s.1, LdSpace.point s.2)).map Prod.snd) = _
   267	      rw [Distribution.map_map, Distribution.map_map]
   268	      rfl
   269	    rw [hmap, map_uniformDistribution_point]
   270	  · have hmap : (dLinePointDist L).map (fun sample => chiIndex L sample.1.seed)
   271	        = ((uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map LdSpace.seed).map (chiIndex L) := by
   272	      change ((((uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map
   273	          fun z => (ldDLineCL L z, ldPointCL L z)).map
   274	          fun s => (dLineDescOf L s.1, LdSpace.point s.2)).map
   275	          fun sample => chiIndex L sample.1.seed) = _
   276	      rw [Distribution.map_map, Distribution.map_map, Distribution.map_map]
   277	      rfl
   278	    rw [hmap, map_uniformDistribution_seed, map_uniformDistribution_chiIndex]

   280	/-- The incidence conclusion of `lem:dlnf`, blueprint
   281	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:113-118`, paper
   282	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:261-272`. -/
   283	theorem dLinePointDist_mem_line (L : LdParams) :
   284	    ∀ sample ∈ (dLinePointDist L).support, sample.2 ∈ sample.1.pointSet := by
   285	  intro sample hsample
   286	  have hsupport : (dLinePointDist L).support =
   287	      ((Finset.univ : Finset (LdSpace L)).image
   288	        fun z => (ldDLineCL L z, ldPointCL L z)).image
   289	        fun s => (dLineDescOf L s.1, LdSpace.point s.2) := rfl
   290	  rw [hsupport] at hsample
   291	  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hsample
   292	  obtain ⟨z, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
   293	  change LdSpace.point z ∈
   294	    linePoints
   295	      (lineRepMap
   296	        (prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed z))
   297	          (prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed z)) (LdSpace.direction z)))
   298	        (lineRepMap
   299	          (prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed z)) (LdSpace.direction z))
   300	          (LdSpace.point z)))
   301	      (prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed z))
   302	        (prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed z)) (LdSpace.direction z)))
   303	  rw [prefixProjection_prefixProjection, lineRepMap_apply_self]
   304	  exact mem_linePoints_lineRepMap _ _
